subject: chemistry

hotspots.label: Absorbing reaction
hotspots.description: The cracked cold pack is an endothermic reaction — it absorbs heat so eagerly that the pack turns freezing cold.
hotspots.positionHint: The cold pack on the left with energy arrows flowing in.
hotspots.function: Shows a reaction absorbing energy from its surroundings.

hotspots.label: Energy flowing in
hotspots.description: When the energy-in layer is on, waves flow from the surroundings INTO the reactions — heat being pulled out, cooling the area.
hotspots.positionHint: The arrows and waves converging on the pack and leaf.
hotspots.function: Shows energy being drawn into the reaction.

hotspots.label: Energy rise
hotspots.description: The energy-levels layer shows the reactants' energy low and the products' high — the gap is the energy the reaction pulls in.
hotspots.positionHint: The short and tall energy bars with the gap between them.
hotspots.function: Shows the energy rise from reactants to products.

visualStyleNotes: Chemistry palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A cracked cold pack and a small leaf float side by side, lit with soft neutral studio light — no bloom, no emissive in the asset (any glow is app-runtime). Clean stylized product-render look, specimen-quality not cartoon. Cold pack: soft pale-blue rounded rectangle with a soft amber accent; leaf: soft muted green simple leaf shape; frost dots: small pale-blue dots. Strong saturated color is reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (slate / amber / molecular-green accents from the Chemistry palette). Slow auto-rotation, calm, minimal chrome.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere, single 2K shared texture atlas. Cold pack: soft pale-blue matte, roughness ~0.55, with a soft amber accent strip. Leaf: soft muted green, roughness ~0.5. Frost dots: small pale-blue, alpha ~0.6. No emissive channels anywhere — the energy-in waves are app runtime effects, not baked in.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: a cold pack and a leaf as endothermic reactions, built to be read as 'the reaction absorbs energy from its surroundings.' Three procedural layers, all clean primitives:

1) MAIN: two endothermic subjects side by side (spacing ~1.4): LEFT a cracked cold pack — a soft pale-blue rounded rectangular pouch (app-rendered crack seam) with small pale-blue frost dots appearing on it; RIGHT a small soft muted green leaf shape on a short stem. Reactant/product glyphs hover faintly (app-rendered).

2) ENERGY IN (toggleable layer): soft arrow shapes and wave arcs flow from the surrounding space INTO the pack and leaf (app-rendered), converging on them — the absorbed heat made visible; the frost dots on the pack brighten as it cools.

3) ENERGY LEVELS (toggleable layer): two simple energy bars float beside the scene (app-rendered) — a SHORT cool-gray bar labeled 'reactants' and a TALL warm-orange bar labeled 'products,' with a soft band between showing the energy pulled in.

Camera: framed so both subjects fit with negative space; auto-rotate default. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: ColdPack, FrostDots, LeafShape, LeafStem, Glyphs, EnergyInArrows, EnergyInWaves, ReactantBar, ProductBar, AbsorbedBand. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
